fixes.what: Add srcset/sizes to every photo slot and the canopy (e.g. 800w/1400w/2000w with sizes="(max-width:1099px) 100vw, 60vw"; canopy 1376w/2752w with sizes="(max-width:768px) 175vw, max(100vw,140vh)")
fixes.why: At 390px each 2000px JPG and the 2752px webp download at full size for a ~350px panel; the heaviest bytes on the page are avoidable.

fixes.what: On phones give the toggle the same hide-while-scrolling-down behaviour as .hww-tab (toggle .is-hidden from the scroll handler) so it only shows when the page is still
fixes.why: Screenshots phone-1 and phone-4: the 36px fixed button sits over the Nikah text and the form note ('…ders included') in the 20px gutter.

fixes.what: Use var(--gold) (or opacity ≥.85) for the Persian pill labels
fixes.why: Gold at 70% over cypress is ≈3.6:1 at 14px; fails WCAG AA 4.5:1 for small text (full gold is ≈6.9:1).

fixes.what: Add .accordion__panel.is-open .accordion__body{pointer-events:auto} (hover-open is already bound on the panel's mouseenter, so nothing breaks)
fixes.why: The open celebration's text cannot be selected or copied on desktop because the full-size trigger button sits over it.

fixes.what: Switch the preloaded, self-hosted fonts to font-display:block (or optional)
fixes.why: swap paints Georgia first then reflows the hero line, statement and pillars when Ramillas lands; with a preload the block window is almost never hit, so this removes the one visible layout shift.

fixes.what: Only call load()/play() when heroVideo.getBoundingClientRect().bottom > 0; otherwise let the IntersectionObserver start it, and add disablepictureinpicture disableremoteplayback to the <video>
fixes.why: A deep link to index.html#inquire (every inner-page 'Inquire' button) starts the 1080 mp4 download and playback off-screen before the observer pauses it.
